unverifiedBoundaries: Not tried against a real @ai-sdk/google plugin and a real Vertex AI publisher base: the fake plugin (internal/plugin/testdata/fake, fake-gemini on @ai-sdk/google) and testenv.FakeVendor stand for them.
The community plugin's own fetch guard (a Vertex credential refused outside the configured Google endpoint) is exercised only through the fake plugin's fetch, not the real plugin's.

Pre-existing and untouched: internal/provider's TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials crashes with 'fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble' on the clean base too (unread-base.log); the package was therefore run in -run ranges around it rather than by weakening it.
Pre-existing and untouched: internal/gateway's TestClaudeClientCacheAbsentUnchanged is red on the clean base (base-pre-existing-claude-cache.log).
